rationale: Unit economics are emerging but not yet proven at scale. $400K ARR at 300 customers implies ~$1,333 ACV, consistent with the stated $150/mo pricing, but no LTV/CAC or gross margin figures were shared.
conviction_points: Revenue and customer count are internally consistent with stated pricing
18% MoM growth with modest headcount suggests reasonable capital efficiency so far
key_concerns: No LTV/CAC or gross margin figures disclosed
18-month runway claim not yet cross-checked against burn rate
questions_for_founders: What's your current gross margin, and what's driving cost-to-serve?
What's your fully-loaded CAC across all channels combined?
diligence_requirements: Full unit economics workup (LTV/CAC, gross margin, payback period)
